text: 中共中央政治局委员、中央外办主任王毅5日在京会见由朝鲜劳动党中央政治局委员、中央书记、国际部部长金成男率领的朝鲜劳动党代表团。王毅表示，今年6月，习近平总书记成功对朝鲜进行国事访问，为新时期中朝关系发展指明前进方向。中方愿同朝方共同落实两党两国最高领导人重要共识，推动中朝关系持续向深向实向好发展。王毅并介绍了中共二十届五中全会主要情况。金成男表示，朝方愿同中方一道，遵循两党两国最高领导人的意志，为发展朝中友好关系作出不懈努力。 (新华社)
text_en: Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Director of the Office of the Central Commission for Foreign Affairs, met in Beijing on the 5th with a delegation of the Workers' Party of Korea led by Kim Song-nam, member of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Secretary of the WPK Central Committee and Director of its International Department. Wang Yi said that in June this year, General Secretary Xi Jinping successfully paid a state visit to the DPRK, charting the course for the development of China-DPRK relations in the new era. China is willing to work with the DPRK to jointly implement the important consensus of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries and push China-DPRK relations to develop continuously in a deeper, more solid and better direction. Wang Yi also briefed on the main points of the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee. Kim Song-nam said the DPRK is willing to work with China, following the will of the top leaders of the two parties and two countries, to make unremitting efforts to develop DPRK-China friendly relations. (Xinhua)
